items.title: Голос наставника важнее библиотеки: люди возвращаются к человеку, а не к каталогу
items.body: Пользователи, которые остаются в приложении годами, называют конкретного голоса или учителя, а не объём контента. Привязанность к живому, непредсказуемому тембру удерживает там, где даже огромный каталог не справляется. Для этих людей уход любимого наставника равнозначен закрытию приложения.

evidence.quote: sleepiest introduced me to something i never knew i was missing out on in 2022. jessica porter. i found her when a sudden 2 month long medical crisis arose that changed my life completely and have been a dedicated listener ever since.

I have used many of the major apps like Waking Up, HeadSpace, and Happier and while I've loved all those platforms and in many ways they introduced me to so many parts of the practice, what I found myself yearning for was more directed guidance from a single teacher.

Cory Muscara is just a wonderful vehicle, an enabler of what's possible. I just went through an intuitive guidance meditation and wow, I have never really been 'there' this is soooo hopeful, soooo promising, soooo enlightening.

items.title: Единственный путь без выбора: отсутствие меню снижает тревогу и удерживает практику
items.body: Приложения с линейным маршрутом и одним голосом называют именно за то, что другие считают недостатком: за отсутствие выбора. Пользователи, которые годами не могли выработать привычку, начинают медитировать ежедневно именно потому, что не нужно ничего решать. Паралич выбора разрушает медитативное намерение ещё до начала сессии.

evidence.quote: I came across The Way in a similar fashion to the other meditation apps I've leveraged previously. In each case in the past, the initial scaffolding was helpful in keeping me on the intended path, but I lost motivation when it ran out. The Way keeps delivering.

I have come to absolutely love this app. What immediately struck me was how it guided me step by step through physical senses. I've tried to meditate solo on and off for 15 years but always drifted. Here there's just one path forward.

For close to 40 years, I have been trying to meditate and in the last 10 days, with FitMind, I have made great strides than I have in the last 40 years. One of the first things I heard about meditations, years ago was, just sit there with your thoughts.

items.title: Принятие вместо избегания: учит бежать навстречу панике, а не от неё
items.body: Для людей с паническим расстройством работает единственный механизм: намеренно вызывать и усиливать тревогу, а не уходить от неё. Приложения, которые строят практику вокруг этого принципа, получают самые сильные отзывы нишевой аудитории и невероятно высокое удержание. Голос, который звучит как живой собеседник, а не синтетическое руководство, критически важен для момента острого приступа.

evidence.quote: As someone who's dealt with anxiety and PTSD for most of their life, it had been your standard case of 'well I'm going to avoid that because it gives me anxiety'. I knew my triggers and what to avoid. DARE flipped this entirely — run toward it.

Panic disorder took my life away from me, and the DARE teachings have helped me get it back. When I began suffering from panic disorder, I downloaded several apps related to anxiety, including DARE. At first, I didn't like this one because it tells you to 'bring it on'.

Anxiety is part of the human condition. We all have it to some degree. I have “dealt” with anxiety for decades, and not always so well. Anxiety is tough enough – and how we treat it (deny it) or self-medicate, can be as bad or worse than th

items.title: Сон как первичный сценарий: половина аудитории приходит в приложение ради засыпания
items.body: Значительная часть людей приходит в медитативные приложения с единственной задачей: отключить голову ночью. Для них медитация не практика осознанности, а инструмент управления бессонницей. Приложение, которое честно проектирует ночной сценарий как отдельный продукт, получает лояльных пользователей, не замечающих никаких конкурентов.

evidence.quote: Sleep, that elusive thing for years has finally arrived. Thanks to Sleepiest and Sleep Wave. I have been listening for over 2 years. At first it was challenging, trying to concentrate on the meditations or hypnosis was work. I was determined.

I have been a slumber user since the slumber app had its first sleep story. As someone with genetic chronic sleep issues, this app is a must. For anyone with sleep problems, slumber has guided me through nights of pain, extreme insomnia, and distress.

During COVID I began suffering from intense insomnia, panic attacks that would last for three or four days without letting up, and major major depression. I was on all these pills and nothing helped. Then I stumbled across Loóna.

items.title: Само приложение должно быть спокойным: тревожный интерфейс убивает намерение
items.body: Люди открывают медитативное приложение в момент стресса, а не из любопытства. Если первый экран встречает агрессивным онбордингом, баннером или непонятной навигацией, пользователь чувствует дополнительную тревогу. Приложение, изменившее привычный интерфейс, получает отзывы о том, что само изменение вызвало тревожный приступ у человека, который пришёл за успокоением.

evidence.quote: I see Headspace is again trying to roll out the new homepage. I was extremely anxious, came to meditate, and when I found this roll out, AGAIN, I felt even *more* unsafe than the last time they tried this.
Out of 5, I would rate simple habit a 4.7. Being inside the app feels like a calm, warm hug. There is clear intention with the colors and pictures within the app.

I cannot recommend this app highly enough. It is a gorgeous and highly accessible app — it has a few different types of meditations, some guided breathing techniques, and some night techniques. All are completely free and without any ads whatsoever.

items.title: Замедление дыхания: простейший физиологический инструмент с немедленным эффектом
items.body: Пользователи, которые скептически относятся к медитации, охотно принимают дыхательные упражнения как «технику», а не духовную практику. Постепенное автоматическое снижение темпа дыхания без резкого старта становится ключевым отличием, которое делает приложение по-настоящему эффективным. Тактильная обратная связь через вибрацию позволяет дышать с закрытыми глазами без касания экрана.

evidence.quote: I really appreciate the way you can start at a number of breaths and then the app progressively adjusts to the desired number of breaths. This gradual approach is what separates it from other apps that just start at the target rate.

This app is just perfect, and does exactly what I need — help me regulate and control my breathing. 10/10. Very well designed in its simplicity. You hear a gentle bell ring (or you can set it to a voice, vibrate and with haptic feedback on Apple Watch).

This app is just perfect, and does exactly what I need - help me regulate and control my breathing. 10/10. Very well designed in its simplicity. You hear a gentle bell ring (or you can set it to a voice, vibrate and with haptic feedback on

items.title: Некоммерческий тон как фактор доверия: деньги не должны чувствоваться внутри сессии
items.body: Приложения, которые воспринимаются как искренне некоммерческие, получают более высокий уровень доверия вне зависимости от фактической модели монетизации. Пользователи замечают мельчайшие детали: рекламу после сессии, давление стрика или баннер в момент открытия. Для людей с ПТСР и паническим расстройством коммерческое давление внутри приложения разрушает само ощущение безопасного пространства.

evidence.quote:
The teaching of Buddhism could be the salvation of the world! Religion is often frowned upon. As a Catholic I have experienced both Conservative and Liberal extremism.
As human beings we all see we have differences in education and opinion.

no payment, no account, no tracking and logging, no advertisements or sharing on social media pop ups. it's the best and it's everything that everything else should be. meditation should be free out of all of the things in the world.
I cannot recommend this app highly enough. All are completely free and without any ads whatsoever. The fact that it's completely free is remarkable for an app of this quality.

items.title: Колокол осознанности в середине дня: механика, которую невозможно скопировать контентом
items.body: Случайный или запланированный звуковой сигнал в середине дня, не требующий открыть приложение, описывают как «трансформирующий механизм» те, кто не смог сформировать привычку через ежедневные сессии. Это совершенно другой продукт: не медитация расписания, а медитация момента. Пользователи часто называют его дополнением к основному приложению, а не заменой.

evidence.quote: I love this app. I usually begin the day with one of the timed 'silent meditations with morning chant,' followed by a short teaching by Thich Nhat Hanh. Before discovering this app, I had always had difficulty focusing during meditation.

O.k., you've set up your life so you are living more spiritual. You meditate, send out good thoughts, try to eat right. And at the same time you live in the real world. As you go into work you tell yourself that you WILL take a breath throughout the day. This bell makes that happen.

Especially being a free app, I highly recommend it. It's simple, lovely, and lightweight, and delivers just what it promises. The daily mindfulness quotes are generally well-chosen, seem to be properly attributed, and come from a variety of traditions.

items.title: Наука, а не мистика: секулярный фрейм открывает медитацию тем, кто давно закрылся
items.body: Значительная часть потенциальной аудитории отвергает медитацию именно из-за духовного языка вокруг неё. Когда приложение объясняет нейробиологию привычки, петли тревоги или механизм нераздвоенного осознавания через научную лексику, оно добирается до людей с аналитическим складом ума, которые безуспешно пытались медитировать годами. Секулярный тон это не упрощение, а разрешение войти.

evidence.quote:
I will highlight the elements to this app that I think make it great both in features and content. 
- Content: Genuine Non-Judgemental attitude surrounding how much you meditate. Once you feel non-dualism as a valid experience of life, you

I have been mediating off and on for my mental health issues for roughly 10 years. I have used multiple apps. Even gone through therapy that involve Metta (loving kindness). This is the first app that I can genuinely say is making a difference.

I didn't think of myself as anxious. Anxiety runs on a continuum. While my heart goes out to those who suffer serious anxiety, this program helped me recognize my own patterns — without any spiritual framing getting in the way.

items.title: Содержательная пустота большого каталога: много треков не означает глубину
items.body: Приложения с сотнями медитаций, но без внутренней логики маршрута, получают отзывы о том, что пользователь «не знает, с чего начать» и уходит. Каталог как полка в магазине не заменяет куратора, который знает именно тебя. Без прогрессии между сессиями большая библиотека создаёт то же тревожное ощущение, от которого человек пришёл спасаться.

evidence.quote: Love so many of the teachers. Can't get enough of Corey Mascura and others. My feedback is largely with the app design itself. How does a mindfulness app with dozens of categories create anxiety about where to start?

It's a fantastic app for anybody interested in mindfulness/meditation/spirituality. I really don't like how they've designed the app to make it seem like you need the subscription based membership to access content when the free tier is actually quite rich.

i've had headspace for over a decade. for the first 3-4 years, I loved it. this app's approach toward meditation and wellness has noticeably shifted since its inception though. When I started, it was Andy Puddicombe doing all of the meditations.

items.title: Учитель с живой традицией против корпоративного голоса: разница ощущается немедленно
items.body: Пользователи, попробовавшие десятки приложений, описывают принципиальное различие: голос, за которым стоит реальная традиция и биография практикующего человека, работает иначе, чем профессиональный диктор. Конкретные учителя с именами и историями создают ощущение, что тебя ведёт человек, который прошёл этот путь, а не озвучил скрипт.

evidence.quote: i am immensely grateful for the revitalized experience of daily living you furnish through teachings of this platform. please never stop.

Greetings to anyone reading this review. I write this with tears of gratitude in my eyes. Deep gratitude for all of the wonderful and helpful guidance offered here and for all at Plum Village who give so much of themselves so we all may benefit.

I've been using this app for several months now. I had run into Mrs. Mindfulness online and love her perspectives. She has worked with a variety of mindfulness 'masters.' The fact that there are real, named teachers behind each session makes it feel different.

items.title: Замороженный каталог убивает удержание: новизна контента для сна важнее его объёма
items.body: Люди с хронической бессонницей прослушивают одни и те же треки снова и снова, пока они не перестают работать. Приложения, регулярно добавляющие новые истории, получают лояльность на годы даже при средней библиотеке. Когда обновления прекращаются, даже пятизвёздочные пользователи начинают писать о том, что «приложение умерло».

evidence.quote: My original review was 5 stars, I loved this app and used it every night. I even purchased a whole year of premium. It was such a scam — they claim to do monthly updates to stories and scapes which they completely stopped doing.

February 2026 Update: This app is very stagnant. I purchased the lifetime membership back in 2020, thinking that new meditations and content would be added periodically. It's now 2026 and none of the meditation 'Plans' have changed.

I really love this app for how often it puts out new content and how fast the team responds. I also love that there is ambient noise you can adjust or add to the meditations. The combination of a new story plus adjustable sound keeps me coming back.

items.title: Стрики в приложении для успокоения: геймификация разрушает медитативное пространство
items.body: Стрики и системы наград повышают вовлечённость в фитнесе, но в медитации создают тревогу того же рода, от которой пользователь пришёл избавиться. Потеря серии из-за технической проблемы называется разрушительной для мотивации продолжать практику. Приложения, которые сознательно отказались от этих механик, получают лояльность именно за это решение.

evidence.quote: I love how simple it is, love that it doesn't require any subscription nor payments. I love the badges, but that's besides my point — what matters is the practice itself is never turned into a competition or a streak.

The recent update got rid of bookmarks. I've lost a good number of guided meditations that I have been collecting for over 5 years. This is very upsetting. Leave the app alone. Life is messed up enough as it is.

I was really excited to forward this to my son. A steady meditation practice could really help him. I tested the app for myself first and wish there were preference adjustment options: SKIP the intro so you don't have to hear it every single time.

items.title: Редизайн как угроза: смена привычного интерфейса ощущается как нарушение ритуала
items.body: Медитативные приложения используются в состоянии повышенной уязвимости: перед сном, во время приступа тревоги, в момент стресса. Любое изменение навигации воспринимается не как обновление, а как нарушение привычного защитного ритуала. Это делает осторожность в отношении любых визуальных изменений особенно важной именно для этой категории продуктов.

evidence.quote: I see Headspace is again trying to roll out the new homepage. I was extremely anxious, came to meditate, and when I found this roll out, AGAIN, I felt even *more* unsafe than the last time they tried this, about a month ago.

Hey there, I've been using medito for over a year now and I must say that it was the greatest meditation app I've ever used. The simple, seamless design was the selling point for me. But ever since the october UI update, it felt like the design lost its soul.

Although it has so many magnificent classic and original stories, the app has gone seriously downhill since being redesigned. It has lost key search categories, particularly 'Favorites' — I no longer know where my trusted tracks are.

items.title: Объяснить механизм важнее, чем вдохновить: понимание зачем удерживает практику
items.body: Большинство медитативных приложений говорят что делать, но не объясняют почему именно это работает. Люди, которые десятилетиями не могли выработать устойчивую практику, закрепляются в ней после того, как получают объяснение нейробиологической или поведенческой логики техники. Урок, предшествующий практике, увеличивает её глубину: тело следует за пониманием.

evidence.quote: Anxiety is part of the human condition. I have 'dealt' with anxiety for decades, and not always so well. This app explains the loop — the habit of anxiety — and suddenly just watching the urge without acting on it becomes possible.

This is a long journey, and even after completion here, I still think my journey will continue. I've been dealing with Chronic Pain and learning how to process my pain — not letting my mind and stress make a mountain out of every signal.

This is the most comprehensive meditation guide I've used. Learn what meditation really is with complementary Theory and Life sections. All sections are filled with expert guest content, allowing for a comprehensive understanding before practice.

items.title: Реклама после сессии разрушает состояние: момент после практики особенно уязвим
items.body: Пауза после медитативной сессии является самым ценным моментом во взаимодействии с продуктом. Именно здесь пользователь наиболее открыт и уязвим. Коммерческая вставка, уведомление или навязчивая кнопка в этот момент воспринимаются как предательство продукта своей миссии. Приложения, которые дают пользователю выйти из сессии в тишину, строят принципиально иной уровень доверия.

evidence.quote: Update: I love this app. But, honestly, I didn't like the tip jar button on the finish screen. However, I understand better now that the developer really does want to make the app available to the most people for the most economical price.

I have over a decade of experience meditating but have fell out of practice for a while. So I wanted to try an app to help me get back into having a consistent practice again. I tried some of the other well known apps (that also cost money)

I absolutely love this app. There is no subscription that you have to buy to use it. Whenever I've had a stressful day I can always count on this to help me unwind without any pop-ups destroying the moment afterward.

items.title: Звук, ставший ритуалом — это и есть продукт, а не демо-контент
items.body: Когда конкретный звук годами помогал засыпать, он перестаёт быть функцией и становится физиологическим триггером — изъятие разрушает именно ту ценность, за которую пользователь готов платить. Настоящий момент для монетизации — до того, как звук стал ритуалом, а не после.

items.body: Согласие на регулярное списание, данное в начале онбординга, не является осознанным выбором — человек ещё не испытал продукт. Настоящее согласие возникает после первого ночного результата, и именно тогда явный запрос воспринимается справедливо, а не как ловушка.

С другой — то, за что держатся годами: точный прогноз, помощь при зачатии, ведение ПКОС, эндометриоза и перименопаузы, дискретность и связь самочувствия с фазами. Одни и те же механизмы повторяются у Flo, Clue, Stardust, Ovia, Femometer, IVY, Life и других — это не придирки к одному приложению, а свойства категории.

Once I hit 10 pregnancies listed, the drop down menu stopped scrolling down far enough for me to select the newest pregnancies/babies, even though I can add more in settings. I just can't actually go to those profiles simply because the scroll doesn't work. There should be no limit to how many pregnancies/births/children I can add
I used this app for my first child and absolutely loved it and just found out I'm expecting again but I can't for the life of me figure out how to add another pregnancy to it
Every time I log in, I have to update my due date. I had my last child almost 8 years ago and her info keeps showing and not my current pregnancy.

I just wish I had to ability to add an additional pregnancy without needing to create a separate account, or overwrite my previous pregnancy data. It's truly only missing this one feature but it would make a big difference in my overall enjoyment and use of the app
I love this app I have used it for both my pregnancies but now I'm pregnant with my 3rd and it's like there's no way possible to add any of my previous pregnancies and make a new one.
I wanted cute milestone pictures of the twins but this app does not support twins. It only does one baby
Doesn't identify baby pics correctly. Full of adult pics and some other pics... Just useless.

items.title: Сценарий потери ребёнка — единственный, где молчание продукта наносит реальный урон
items.body: Приложение, продолжающее присылать уведомления «мама первого триместра» после потери и передающее данные детским брендам, наносит реальный урон. Продукт, у которого есть бережный выход из этого состояния, получает лояльность, которую ничем другим не заработать.

evidence.quote: I opened my app to see the little baby growth and all I see today are articles about miscarriage.
evidence.quoteRu: Открыла приложение посмотреть, как растёт малыш, а сегодня вижу только статьи про выкидыш.

evidence.quote: Beware, they sell you information to people about your pregnancy but apparently not about your loss. As if I didn't have enough reminders about the baby I lost, one of their advertisers sent my a very insensitive box formula samples for a baby that died months ago.

at least 1 to 3 times per week I receive notifications that are an ad, some of which say something along the lines of "Hey there First Trimester Mom! Get started on your registry with Amazon!". This is extremely upsetting for a grieving family to see.
My little interactive fetus was replaced by several articles about miscarriage and pregnancy loss.
I miscarried and now I am receiving free samples of baby formula. Feels like I'm being punched in the face whenever I get the mail. They must have sold my name and address to these companies.

items.title: Контент, синхронизированный с биологическим календарём, создаёт ежедневный повод открыть приложение
items.body: Обновление о развитии плода именно на этой неделе, 3D-визуализация и статьи под текущий срок — всё это превращает приложение в ритуал возвращения на девять месяцев без единого напоминания. Главное удержание категории строится не на функции, а на нарративе.

evidence.quote: From the size of your baby, to the organs that are developing week by week, you're able to fully understand what all is going on
evidence.quoteRu: От размера малыша до органов, которые развиваются неделя за неделей, — можно полностью понять, что происходит.

evidence.quote: I have learned so much from this app for all of my pregnancies and am so grateful for the excitement it brings each week.
I used it my whole pregnancy brought me comfort in knowing things and being able to check what's my baby's size weekly was really cool
Keeps me looking forward to checking in on baby's development. Very informative with the biology too.
I get to show my older children what the baby is looking like week by week and they find it so fascinating. It's a way they can connect with their new sibling in a way
My 3 kids love seeing the 3D baby weekly update and reading about their sibling's growth! I love including them in this pregnancy!

I've used this pregnancy app for three babies now and I'll definitely never use a different one. This is the one that is just hands down the most in depth. It makes you feel the most connected. It's almost as if you're able to look at an ultrasound whenever you want now, especially with the videos that they have that go in depth about everything that's happening with baby developmentally each week
The 3D model of development alone is something I can spend hours looking at. It's really so cool and amazing. Beyond that the app has everything, I'm just stuck at the visuals
I'm on this everyday it's amazing to see how much they change in such little time and it's very good at explaining what is happening to my body I love it
I was getting super emotional, feeling guilty, helpless, and detached. I decided to read through a section on this app. Exactly what I told my husband was going on was the same on this app
I like that it has articles and updates for all things during each week. I'm still early in my pregnancy, but this is much more helpful than other apps I've tried
Прекрасное приложение благодаря ему ощущаю поддержку на протяжении всего срока, все есть , захожу каждый день , очень много информации узнала , каждая статья написана грамотно и интересно
every day new articles on advice or questions that have been on my mind and reassurance that everything will be ok!! it's helped me find other apps that help as well !!
Very informational about each month and the baby's growth and what it looks like in each stage and feelings you might experience as you progress

A very clear outlook on what is happening in your pregnancy and what to expect in the future… as I hit each milestone and experienced each symptom, I was already informed about it which put me at a lot of ease ❤️
Comes with details of each week just in case you get confuse on the symptoms you're experiencing as a first time parent.

items.title: Продукт «спит» год-два и оживает со следующим ребёнком — это самая длинная петля удержания в мобайле
items.body: Пользователи прямо пишут, что вернулись через 6-8 лет с новой беременностью — и это уникальный актив категории. Семья, прошедшая весь первый путь с продуктом, при возврате даёт его бабушкам и няне, удваивая охват без единого привлечения.

evidence.quote: I have been using this app since 2019 when I got pregnant with baby number one and I'm now on baby number three. My son loves how easy it is to navigate so he can see how much his siblings are growing week by week!
Very easy to use been using it since 2018 and it's know 2026
I've been usung this qpp since my first pregnancy almost 12years ago.
I've been using this app since 2017 during my first pregnancy, it's been so helpful especially when i had issues and complications along the way in all my pregnancies!
It helped us build patterns and routines for both of our babies.
It links between family members. You can have multiple kids. Track feeding, breast milk storage, growth, medications. We LOVE it!

I have now used this app for three children, I did pay for the premium subscription and it is worth every penny! At our first pediatrician appointment with our first born, we were stunned at how many questions they ask regarding feeding and diapers. We felt very unprepared. This app has helped us to track babies dai…
it's one of the very few apps for moms with multiples. and aside from that, it's very very easy to use.

I've used it with my 2 babies so far and I will never use another app if we have any more kiddos because I love this one so much! I love everything about it from the realistic style images of baby growing to the breakdown of what's happening in the womb/with mama. 10/10 an amazing & well made app
I have used this App with every pregnancy. It's the best one out there.
Over 6 years ago I used this app for my first pregnancy. I just found out I'm pregnant and I'm so happy this app is still here for me to use again this time around!

I have a kid already. She turns 20 this year. So it could have argued that i know all the answers. But with second one coming in next year i feel more dumb than ever about the kids so thanks Universe for this app. It educates me and my lady perfectly.

I used the wonder weeks app 3 years ago with my daughter. It was insanely accurate for us. Anytime she wasn't herself, I'd check the app and sure enough she'd either be just starting a leap or just about to.
I was feeling guilty about not paying as much attention to milestones, etc for my 2nd baby but having this app has helped me feel more attuned to what my baby is going through in an easy way!

My friend bought this app for me to track my second child and it is a game changer! I felt like I was always guessing what was going on with my first. This time around, with my experience with my first and the wonder weeks app in my back pocket, I don't have to guess anymore.
I have used this for both my babies and it is so insightful and helpful to know what’s going on and why

items.title: Общий журнал нескольких опекунов заменяет устную передачу дежурства
items.body: Когда мама, папа, бабушка и няня видят одну и ту же картину в реальном времени — исчезает главный источник тревоги ухода: неизвестность. Именно этот механизм пользователи называют причиной, по которой они прощают продукту всё остальное.

evidence.quote: 我已经用了十多年了，非常好用，而且功能齐全，我几乎推荐给了我所有的宝妈宝爸，他们反馈也很好用，不管谁记录了，大家都能看到，即使宝妈外出，也可以随时随地了解宝宝的情况，让妈妈更安心，全面的记录宝宝的成长经历，还可以添加一些新的选项和图片，这将是宝宝最初的最完整的成长轨迹档案

My husband and even the grandparents use it from my phone when we stay with them too, easy to explain! This is our first baby so this was just what we needed to keep peace of mind and not go too long between anything! The $5 is WELL worth it for “premium”/no ADs.
it syncs easily with your partner's phone
I especially loved that you can have multiple people connect to your account, so if someone is babysitting they can input right into the app.
First time dad and I love that we can both take turns at night and log this without disturbing each other.
Especially when you don't know who did what and when. With this app we have an idea when our daughter is expected to be hungry, fall asleep, and to. Track her poos/pees/actives each day
My husband and I have loved both being able to log things and keep things as organized as possible.
As a first time mom, this app has helped my partner and I so much in the early days to keep track of feeds and sleep while operating different shifts.

items.title: Превращение тревоги в наблюдаемые данные — главная работа, которую выполняет категория
items.body: «Мой ребёнок не сломан, это нормальная фаза» — объяснение до того, как симптом напугал, ценится выше любой функции отслеживания. Пользователи описывают это как «ощущение, что рядом есть кто-то знающий», и именно здесь категория соперничает с педиатром.

evidence.quote: I have used this app for all 4 of my children and it honestly helped keep me sane with all the unexpected things changing and happening with me and them.
It's really helping me get through the scary parts and I feel like I'm learning a lot through this app.
Comes with details of each week just in case you get confuse on the symptoms you're experiencing as a first time parent.
As a first time mom this was more helpful than my care team
It helped me understand my baby's brain, their needs, and it helped me understand that I wasn't messing up
it brought me great comfort to know it wasn't some vague untreatable thing... Rather, these were developmental leaps that all babies go through

It’s so helpful to know why my baby is upset! It helps me help her, and also gives me much more compassion rather than annoyance or frustration when she is fussy! It also has amazing tips, activities to do with your baby, and videos to explain what’s going on in their development! 10/10 app!
Not only does it help me understand how my baby is experiencing the world, but it is a big relief to know that my baby isn't the only one having a sleep regression or going through a cranky phase.

We scheduled life around his leaps and it made us more present for him and less stressed out. Being first time parents, had we not had wonder weeks, I’d have thought he were ill and brought him to the pediatrician! I plan on using wonder weeks with our second baby, coming in just a few weeks,
Just knowing when a leap is coming prepares us for the rough seas and understanding what our littles are going through makes it a lot less frustrating.
Being informed is something that helps bring me peace and that's exactly what this app does.
It's been super helpful to have a general idea of when fussy times are ahead so my anxious brain doesn't go into overdrive

The tracking tools and sleep recommendations helped me better understand my baby's needs and gave me confidence in my daily routine. More than anything, this app gave me peace of mind and the confidence to be the best mom I can be
We were able to naturally see patterns in her sleep and wake windows to support her to get the BEST sleep for the whole family.
It has also helped me learn my individual babies cues much faster.

I thought my baby was teething for 2 weeks until my sister in law told me about this app, and I quickly learned she was just tired and needed help getting to sleep more often. Life has been a dream ever since I started using Huckleberry.

items.title: Журнал кормлений становится медицинским аргументом — это уже другой уровень ценности
items.body: График сна и питания вместо расплывчатого «ел где-то каждые три часа» меняет разговор с педиатром. Когда приложение помогает поймать обезвоживание или объяснить режим — оно становится инструментом здоровья, а не просто удобством.

evidence.quote: There are other tracker apps with more functions but frankly this app covers everything your doctor is going to ask about and more.
I am very organized and this app definitely helps you keep track and organize especially when doctors ask you how many diaper changes and feeding times.
it's quick and easy to check what she's done and if it's a good amount or not. Anytime a doctor or pediatrician asks questions
It helped me set a nap/sleep schedule and anticipate it.
My baby was having problems gaining weight and it helped me track how much he was eating and also the diapers.

You go to their dr. Appointments and they ask how many diapers they use a day boom in the app. How long the breastfeed/bottle feed boom in the app. Need to keep track of medication? In the app. It's all in once place
However I started tracking at least diaper changes from day 1 & quickly fell in love!! Having the help keeping track of info my pediatrician would ask in those 1st few visits was SO helpful.
Also makes it easy when we go to se the doctor and they ask questions about her sleep and eating and we can just pull out the reports and show them.

great for labor and labor and support to have something to focus on... It was great to be able to provide a history to my provider when I went in and we even used it in hospital when the monitors were off
Was a great way to feel prepared when calling triage to ask if I should come in.
Guy friendly. Start | Stop buttons and for $0.99 you get email so you can send the Dr. or your Doula copies of the contractions so they have a copy.
The two-clicks to record a contraction was so easy and my midwife loved checking in on me by seeing the screenshots.
I also like the weekly updates and the tools like the kick counter and symptom tracker—they really help me stay organized and feel more in control.
I like that it lets me know of possible symptoms, and I'm able to track them in my journal, which makes chatting with my doctor way easier!

I love this app it gives me a estimate of how big my baby is, and I can track my symptoms so it shows if something is consistent or off. It also gives you very good information about the baby as it grows, and it changed weekly to keep you posted and aware what’s happening in your body.
This app helps me keep track of my baby and helps me navigate symptoms I'm having!

items.title: Полная функциональность без ловушек читается как уважение — и становится конкурентным преимуществом
items.body: В категории, где конкуренты вставляют посторонний контент в самый напряжённый момент, «работает полностью и не отвлекает в три ночи» само по себе становится причиной выбора — пользователи называют это честностью и рекомендуют за это.

evidence.quote: it doesn't ask you at 3 in the morning when you're blurry eyed feeding a baby "are you enjoying baby tracker?"
We use the free version with the family sharing option. It's perfect because my husband and I can each track and the others app will be updated
This app is better than huckleberry and it allows the widgets with timers for free.

Very analytically driven but super easy to use also there are add with the free version but they are almost impossible to notice just a banner at the bottom no locked features or micro transactions makes me feel good that these services still exist.
only one i could find that is free and super easy to use i love it

i get so many break downs of all the changes throughout the week, i love that i get to see what the baby looks like, while also showing how it changes the body! i love that i don't need to pay for anything as well!

You can customize the category of the baby's size to be something other than fruits and it has cool short videos of how big the baby is and what's happening with the baby at each week. I appreciate that the app is free but still offers more than what you need for education and resources!
this is my first kid and i have been through so many apps trying to find one that will give me info without having to pay a ton of money.
I've tried a lot of pregnancy trackers, and this one is my favorite! Even the free version has excellent features

It has wonderful education and resources available for free, no ads, easy to use. It really made it so my husband could experience more of the pregnancy with me early on. Every week he looked forward to looking at the app updates together. 🩷 I 100% recommend this app! Thanks so much to the people involved in making…

You don't have to pay and it has so much information its so cool. You can see the size of your baby by different fruits, animals, and sweets. Coolest thing ever!! Also tells a lot of helpful information and whats going on inside of you.
Every single other app I have tried want you to pay an outrageous amount and still doesn't even have half as much as this does and the other apps have too many adds I recommend this app to everyone
Has the ability to include intensity, edit contractions, shows averages and graphs, and even shows a timer so I have a reasonable guesstimate of when my next contraction will happen.
Quick, easy, no ads, no premium version… just a simple, self explanatory app that performed exactly as I needed it to.
No bells and whistles here. This app does exactly what you'd expect it to do. not blocking the simple features for a paid version
As a third time mom, I was quickly looking for an app that I can use, since it's a one time use. This app is perfect and did not disappoint

items.title: «Когда последний раз кормил» без разблокировки телефона — главный быстрый сценарий категории
items.body: Живой таймер на экране блокировки — самая цитируемая причина выбора конкретного трекера. Тот, кто сделает этот сценарий надёжным через обновления и смены устройств, забирает самую лояльную часть аудитории.

evidence.quote: I have added this app to my lock screen gadget so it makes it easier for me to tell the times between feedings or pump.

One last thing - the sleep logger is amazing. When you mark that your kid is asleep, it starts a live timer that shows up on your Home Screen, which minimizes the # of times you have to open your app.
It also supports Live Activities, which is what I've been looking for so I don't accidentally leave timers running forever!
It has brought such ease tracking everything with my twin babies! I think my absolute favorite is being able to add a widget to my Lock Screen and simply click it to add a new log.

My favorite part is the widget that shows how long it has been since she last ate. Postpartum hits hard and quick once you get home from the hospital and that feature alone saved mine and my husband's sanity a million times
Perfect way to track everything and get updates at a glance with the widget and live activity.

This is a godsend for remembering when I fed my baby last! Pregnancy made me forgetful cuz of no sleep and this shows me last time baby ate even on locked screen. Up on top it also shows the timing of how long he's been eating on each side so I can look at other stuff while feeding.

Our favorite feature is the live updates allowing you to see the time past since their last feeding and how long they've been sleeping right from your Lock Screen, without having to calculate it yourself or click all the way into the app

items.title: Первый ответ — это кредит доверия: ошибка на базовом виде его обнуляет
items.body: Пользователь начинает не с редкого вида, а с базилика на подоконнике или воробья за окном — и именно там первый промах разрушает доверие ко всему продукту. Точность на самом обычном — это минимальная ставка на вход, а не конкурентное преимущество.

evidence.quote: It keeps misidentifying plants. Also, misdiagnosis even after several pictures.
Twice it completely misidentified my seedlings, neither of which was at all exotic (pumpkin and Gerber Daisy).
The app hasn't been right about anything yet. Hasn't correctly identified a plant. Just me a brand new plant is unhealthy when it's beautiful and perfect and identifies it incorrectly.
It called every single plant a snake plant and not a single one is a snake plant( one is a pineapple plant)
The app doesn't properly identify plants. Did a few test runs and the app was 0/10
Referred to Zoysia as Bermuda
Called my Iris a dandelion…

Do NOT waste your money or time on this app! I purchased it to help me identify the different varietals of basil coming up in my garden as I have volunteers from seasons past. It could not even identify a basil as a basil let alone the different varietals.

Identifies wrong more than right. This morning it identified my cucumbers as squash, then oregano, then yet something else, and refused to identify my strawberries when I clearly put them in the entire picture.
It doesn't have half of the pretty common plants grown in the Midwest in gardens and flower pots. I had to manually ID 1/3-1/2 of the plants

It couldn't identify basic herbs in my garden that had labels with them. I attempted to identify 15 plants in my garden (that I already knew of course) just to make sure it knew, and the only think it got partially correct was a tomato plant.
It identified 0 out of 8 plants I tried it on and which I know. I canceled my free trial.
Id Kentucky bluegrass as Mormon tea. Similar screwups galore.

If you want false information try this plant.It said my plant was pepino but it was crimson watermelon, and whenever I tried to take a picture it asked me to pay! Why do you have to pay for seeing. What disease it has

This app completely failed to do what it claimed. It couldn't correctly identify even basic plants. The developer is impossible to reach. Their website's support link doesn't work, and they don't respond on Instagram.
I have tried 3 times to contact someone at Planty, I was charged immediately with no trial time, my first attempt at identifying a tree was not correct.

items.title: Одинаковое фото — разный ответ: нестабильность уничтожает ценность точности
items.body: Пользователи сами проверяют приложение, делая повторные снимки одного объекта, и видят разные результаты — рулетку вместо знания. Стабильность вывода важнее средней точности: непоследовательный ответ воспринимается как ложь.

evidence.quote: It identified the same bird (different shots) as 4 different species, but overall A terrific app! I also enjoy the sounds which match what I heard from the birds I was photographing.
evidence.quoteRu: Одну и ту же птицу (на разных кадрах) оно определило как 4 разных вида, но в целом отличное приложение! Ещё нравятся звуки — они совпадали с тем, что я слышал от снятых птиц.

evidence.quote: Tried to identify small grapefruit tree few times. Got completely different response, including holly. None were correct.
However, I can snap a shot of the same grass or plant 2-3 times and this app gives me 3 different types of names for the same picture taken of the same plant or grass area.
a camel cricket... it kept identifying it as either a beetle or a squirrel
I put in two photos of the same bug to get a better angle and it identified it as a different bug both times
as it will still give me 3-5 different 'identifications' for one single specimen

Camera will often identify a plant from the blurriest photo/camera angle, but somehow cannot identify a rose bush with rose blooms or a canna lily with a bloom?? For both of those, it did not even attempt to begin identifying, no matter which angle or how far away I was.
Same clear picture three different answers Right out of ten are wrong every time Useless app
The identifier isn't very accurate. Will give different results of the same plant when you take different pictures
I used it on 4 pieces of the same tree an got 4 different answers. 10/10 would NOT use again.
My free trial ended with four pictures of the same plant yielding four different results and then telling me I have to pay to keep getting the wrong results. Deleting app now.
I cut a leafy twig off a shrub and scanned it from 5 times. I got 5 different results.
I kept taking pictures of the plant I wanted to identifier, and it kept showing me different plants and their names. I finally gave up and I want to cancel this before it goes into a subscription.
I took a picture of the same bush 10 Times and it gave me ten different plants

This app has been difficult to use and totally inconsistent. I have been unable to identify plants because each time I take a picture of them, the app identifies them differently. I will be canceling this if I can figure out how.
You can scan the same tree twice and it will give you complete different information. However, the weekly cost of $8 is too high.

items.title: Геолокация без фильтра по ареалу — это полуфабрикат, не продукт
items.body: Пользователь в Великобритании получает карикарных северо-американских птиц, пользователь в ЮАР — американский список. Проверка «водится ли вид здесь» — одна из самых дешёвых в реализации и одна из самых высокоценных для доверия.

evidence.quote: unless I am willing to pay 💰for a subscription I don't get accurate results for the sound identification feature. results were of a species of Toucan found in Columbia. the result kept coming back, incorrectly, as a Common Nightingale, which is found in Europe, Asia Minor, the Middle East, and Central Asia…but Not in New England.
Only identified one bird accurately which was a crow. It only wants to identify American birds don't waste your money or time

Has transformed walks where can hear birdsong but not be able to see the feathery source. There's something magical about seeing the singer appear. The only improvement is that the bird identified is from an entirely different region of the globe. Mistakes are too frequent to be realistic.
Why being in South Africa am I getting American birds?
USA biased - often incorrect in the uk
In asian hotel, ID bug 73% as from N.A. So maybe not hotel's fault.
almost every bug i've tried to identify (about 4) , the app tells me they're insects from europe, africa etc when I am in North america

bird buddy can identify birds better by eliminating species that are out of geographical range. For example, up in Seattle, where I'm at; I can assure you the bird at my feeder is not a Northern Cardinal, Painted Bunting, or Blue Jay
they know where I am located, the tech should know better than to ID as a Black-capped Chickadee when that species doesn't live anywhere near me
A bird was sound id'd by this app as a Louisiana Waterthrush. the chances of a Louisiana Waterthrush showing up in our forests are LOW to NONE. which is weird since the app knew my location, etc.
I recorded two birds. The first said it was a marsh wren. I live in the desert. The second said it was a great horned out. Sitting outside my window at ten AM? It's not.
This app keeps identifying birds as American species. I am in Europe, location is available tintje app. It is simply not working
The app returned an ID of Mouse Spider for a spider in my home in Texas. According to all other sources I can find, this spider is not found in North America.

items.title: Обновление, ломающее ключевую механику — это откат продукта, а не апдейт
items.body: Долгосрочные пользователи фиксируют конкретные регрессии: микрофон, компас, звуковое распознавание — перестают работать после апдейта. Для аудитории природы стабильность уже любимого поведения ценнее любой новой функции.
apps: Merlin Bird ID by Cornell Lab

evidence.quote: It claims it's not being given permission by my iPhone to access the microphone, but when I go to Settings as it requests, everything is turned on. There's nothing else to do
evidence.app: Merlin Bird ID by Cornell Lab

evidence.quote: Now every time I open it it's pointing NORTH no matter which direction I'm facing. And when I roll my finger across to set up the correct direction, it fails to move at all when I scroll around the sky.
After this latest upgrade, the compass is WAY off. Same phone, same place, compass off by several degrees.
Sadly, the app no longer detects sounds. I still use it for photo identification but I'm hoping any upcoming updates will restore its ability to detect sound and identify birds
evidence.app: Merlin Bird ID by Cornell Lab

evidence.quote: For the past few days, however, it isn't picking up a lot of the birds I'm hearing. Or it identifies every bird as a cardinal... it has a tendency to identify anything it can't figure out as an osprey
evidence.app: Merlin Bird ID by Cornell Lab

evidence.quote: This app was wonderful a year ago when it didn't take all of its good features away and the identifier got worse!

with the newer AI powered version, it's not doing great. Today it told me that ducks (with green heads) were a 'canada goose'. Yesterday it claimed a pelican (with a trademark long pelican beak) was a 'common merganser'

it had a solid history of great ratings, then longtime users began modifying their reviews with reports of concerns identical to those I am seeing as a new user... That indicates some issue in the development cycle that has either introduced a bug, or has added some 'improvement' causing unintended consequences
The app now freezes whenever identifying. Used to be 5 stars. Now a buggy mess.

I’m not sure why you guys have changed things, but I used to be able to open my app press the compass button and my phone finds it its way in the sky. Now it is doing something completely different and it is not finding its way in the sky at all. Now there is an option to use my camera for augmented reality? Why? I…

I used to use this to identify constellations in the sky by pointing my phone at it. Now, the compass literally never points to where I want. Even by shifting the "compass direction" at the bottom, it can't get the orientation right. Bummer. Looking for another app :/
This app used to be 100% reliable. Now, it rarely even recognizes ANYTHING is in view let alone identifying it. Others say they've added AI
The app releases are not tested and always buggy. They are moving fundamental features into a paid model outside of the standard ones they originally sold it as.
Live view hangs and never loads
After set up on Christmas Day, our Bird Buddy Bird Buddy worked fine until I downloaded the software update on December 26th. Now it won't load the live camera feed at all!

I love my bird buddy and before today I would have given 5 stars but I’m so annoyed with the newest update - they changed how to save pictures and videos without any notification and I accidentally deleted a rare species just doing what I normally do after viewing a video - programmers should know you need to advise…

items.title: Диагноз без рекомендации — это полезность, остановленная на полпути
items.body: Пользователь фотографирует больное растение, чтобы понять, что делать — а получает список из пяти гипотез. Ценность заканчивается там, где начинается выбор: конкретный, дифференцированный по виду план действий — это и есть настоящий продукт.

evidence.quote: plant identification does not work for uncommon plants, desease identification does not allow specifying the plant.
evidence.quoteRu: Определение растений не работает для редких видов, а в определении болезней нельзя указать само растение.

evidence.quote: Diagnosis of problems, though based on multiple photos, seems to be generic. It doesn't tell you what the actual problem is; it just gives you a list of common problems

Can't find phone number to your company,  I get bogus diagnoses for my plants and all recommended advise is the same on all my plants.  And don't fall for their free trail date, there no way to cancel the app before they take your money
I downloaded the app to get treatment for my plant and nothing. Only that the plant was sick. Hello, I know that.
it couldn't ID plant disease (simple rust) from pictures I took but confirmed what I thought when I typed it in.
This app told me my plant either was overwatered or underwater. I knew that, I wanted to know which one. Very useless. Deleted and canceled within five minutes.
Every response I get says " maybe too much water, maybe not enough water, maybe disease…". I knew that without the app. Never a definitive diagnosis.
It did identify the plant and the problem but no suggestion on how to fix it. I had to look at a different website to find a fix. There are better plant apps that give you more information.
Every plant I have had issues with the app tells me the same thing - brown spots- over watered under watered, bacteria issues use chemicals! Not happy with app
when using the disease identifier, it's very vague & usually just says "mechanical disease" and the advice it gives is to know what causes disease and prevent it
With everything I tried to identify it gave the same vague answer that was bugs feeding on the leaf. Even things that I know are fungal. This is garbage.

I got the app because I have a fruit tree that is sick and wanted to know what kind of sickness it was and how to treat it but the app recognized the tree but not what was wrong with it I took pictures of different plants and I noticed that it gave me the same answers for all of them…
First it could not even identify it properly and then then I tried to diagnose the problem the app told me that the tree was healthy.
Same diagnosis every plant
They gave me 6 things that could be the cause. False advertisement for sure.
gives you roughly the exact same care instructions for every plant, which is not accurate. i've learned SO much more from youtube videos than from this app

items.title: Совет без учёта вида и климата убивает растение — и репутацию продукта
items.body: Пользователи точно следовали советам по поливу и потеряли растения; графики рассчитывались без привязки к виду, горшку и сезону. Когда продукт берётся за уход — он берёт на себя ответственность за исход, а не за количество функций.

evidence.quote: This app is useful since I now know which plants we've bought over the years, but DO NOT use its water calculator because it's absolutely wrong and you will drown your plants if you follow them.

Told me lies on how to take care of my plants resulting in most of them dying when I took their advice. It could not identify any plant correctly it said basic cloves were some weird Asian fruit. Do not support these scam artists.
It measured all my pots and it wants me to overwater. I had water all over my floor
Followed watering instructions, fertilizing instructions, and still killed my plant.

I asked what the plant needed! It was very vague, over watering, underwatering ect! it would show you things to put in the water and none of the 3 I took pictures of gave me any details to help the plant
It told me general information that I could have received from Google. It was not specific.
This was not what I expected I need solutions to problems not long discourses on what the plant is.
I signed up for this app and then it was giving me the wrong information on the plants I have.
Care instructions are incorrect, the botanist doesn't take into account regional differences in plant care in guidelines as well as climate, weather
The advice I found was the complete opposite of what the app said. I don't think the care tips were specific to that plant. They looked like they were very general tips
When I ck'd on a plant and needed more information on it, I had to purchase the app and then it gave me basically no information.
Information on plants was so generic and not helpful. Definitely not worth paying $8 a month!!
It also wants to make a general watering schedule for all the plants that are the same which is not correct. Every plant has different needs.
Oh and half my plants actually ended up dying from being overwatered because of how frequent it has you watering your plants.

items.title: Стор обещает свободный вход — приложение требует выбор тарифа с первой секунды
items.body: Пользователи устанавливают приложение и обнаруживают, что никакой версии без обязательства не существует — сразу экран с тарифами. Это не монетизация, а разрушение доверия ещё до первого опыта — и фоновый шум, на котором горят честные продукты всей ниши.

evidence.quote: it "requires" that users agree to pay for it starting on day 8
it said it was free although the app talks about free 3 day trial then it is $6.99 a week… not into that. still seems deceptive?
It says free app but when you put all your information and app is downloaded, it ask you for a monthly payment plan.
Haven’t tried it yet but it is advising that I have a free trial period and then I have to pay a subscription for it. Bait and switch.
on the App Store it's free but when you get on the app you have to pay or have a free trial for 7 days.

While it is free, you would need to pay for the diagnostic portion of it, which is what I needed it for in the first place. There is a free trial that lasts for 3 days and then they will charge you for it.
The advertisement showed scanning a plant and a cool thing like add milk, coffee etc popped up. I couldn't try the app without subscribing to it

This app is extremely misleading as it was advertised as free plant identification help but as soon as I open the app it requests which of the subscription options I would like. The answer was none since I was looking for free
I downloaded this app, because it said it was a free app in the Google search. It's not free. It's a free trial. They did identify three plants for me. Then they wanted to charge money.
Should not say it's free then charge $30 a year for this app
When I googled apps for plant identification, this app comes up as "free plant identifier." You can't use it without a subscription.
Subscription app, says it's free, it is to download, but to use it you have to subscribe. They are banking on you forgetting the free trial and not canceling it.
The original advertisement said free. When I tapped to install I was charged 8 dollars a month. I was deceived and will find a way to cancel.

It was advertised as being free and I want it canceled immediately. Not surprisingly it is difficult to figure out how to do that so please let this review serve as my formal request of management to immediately terminate this app before I am charged anything but also to respond with instructions for all those other…
This app is not free. If you add more than one plant you have to pay the premium. Totally false and deceptive only use if you have one plant in your garden.
This app is FREE TO DOWNLOAD. Then they want to charge you a subscription to use the app. Sad really, lots of people could actually benefit from an actual FREE version.

items.title: «Семь дней без обязательств» обязано означать ровно это — иначе это обман
items.body: Самый воспроизводимый сценарий во всём каталоге: пользователь активирует ознакомительный период, на следующий день видит полное снятие средств. Мгновенное выставление счёта под видом «сначала попробуй» — это не удержание, это сожжённая лояльность.

evidence.quote: I signed onto this app for 2 days. I was under the impression that there was a free trial period. Two days later I found a charge on my acct for $6.99 + tax for a total of $7.41. What happened to the free trial???
Charged me after I canceled

Why was I charged $39.99 on day 1 of a free week's trial? I wanted to try it first but received a msg that it would expire on March 25, 2025, and showed a billing of $39.99. This is not how it is promoted!
It says nothing about paying $50 when you instal it. Then after 2 plants they keep harassing you for buying a plan or they wont allow you to identify a 3rd plant. Removing them.
Cannot bypass the screen to sign up for a paid plan and just use the app for free. Shady.
Even the one week free trial asks for your credit card in hopes to hook you or steal your money if you don't remember to cancel
It didn't even let me take one picture or let me use the app without paying first
I was trying the free trial BEFORE purchase and yet I was charged $10.54 ($9.99 + tax).
It's $7/week and just shows as a charge from apple so you can go a while without noticing
I used it for a few minutes then canceled the subscription. I was still charged $6.99
Did not honor the one-week free trial. Charged me for a month, even though I cancelled it before the supposed one-week free trial ended!
They say it's a free trial but right away charge your card then don't give correct information.
I signed up for the free trial knowing I could cancel at anytime before the trial is up and it automatically charged my account $9.99 when I signed up. Very bad bait and switch.

This company takes your money without your permission during your trial. The second day actually and then, when you try to contact them, they will not allow your message to even be sent anyone who’s looking at this app please do not try you’ll be totally disappointing and overcharged.I could giv
Offers 3 days free but bills for a month before 3 days is up. Unethical
I did the trial but unsubscribed after 1 day. However was charged $17.30 for 2 weeks. Be careful

items.title: Отмена должна означать конец — продолжение списаний превращает продукт в угрозу
items.body: Пользователи удаляют приложение, отменяют доступ — и продолжают видеть еженедельные списания месяцами; часть блокирует карту, чтобы остановить их. Продукт, который нельзя выключить, воспринимается как враг, а не как сервис.

evidence.quote: I do not want this app but see no way of deleting it and I do t want to be charged for it
evidence.quoteRu: Мне это приложение не нужно, но я не вижу, как его удалить, и не хочу, чтобы с меня за него списывали деньги.

evidence.quote: Despite canceling during the free trial period keeps charging my credit card every week !!!!!!. despite canceling the subscription the same day as I started ( while they advertise 3 days of free trial), my card got charged. my bank had to block charges from this company as it kept charging repeatedly
I tried the 1 week free trial, got charged immediately instead of after the first week.

They tried to charge my card after I canceled my trial. I had to call my bank to stop the payment. Then they went around another way to charge me today and it went through. If you cancel you might have to get a new card to stop them.
They charged me for MONTHS after cancelling. EVERY WEEK. Only paid me 6.99 back.
I canceled this subscription in April 2026 through Apple under manage subscriptions. I was then charged $24.99 by Plant App on May 19, 2026.
Trial membership was cancelled before period ended and yet I still keep getting charged $59.99 every month.
Even canceling within the free trial period, they have continued to charge me for the last four months.
I cancelled the subscription shortly after I started it because the app did not meet my needs. 3 days later I was charged for it!!! Don’t trust them!!!!

I am beyond angry, this app has been charging me twice a week without my knowledge. I have not been contacted by anyone despite sending emails about this. Not only have the been charging me twice but I have tried to cancel it multiple times just to be charged again. DO NOT DOWNLOAD this app
tried to cancel subscription numerous times and they continued charging me
I checked the box for opting out of automatic renewal... I thought I canceled my subscription 3 times and yet was still getting charged months after.
I tried to unsubscribe and have been charged even though it has been cancelled and deleted from my phone. I was just charged again! This is ridiculous and I’m very disappointed.
I deleted this app and was still charged weekly for it. Never got any of my money back. App is horrible.
No way to cancel it so I shut down my account. The weekly payment of 6.99 persisted so I tried to contact them and they still haven't gotten back to me after 2 months.
Helpful 🙄 I canceled my subscription but was still charged another week. Not worth the money

items.title: Невозможность выйти — это разрушение доверия, зашитое в архитектуру
items.body: Кнопка отмены отсутствует в стандартных настройках, ведёт в тупик или не отвечает — пользователи пишут десятки писем без ответа и идут в банк. Когда выход из продукта труднее, чем вход — это не удержание, а ловушка.

evidence.quote: Two years in a row I have lost access to my annual subscription mid year. Last year they were able to restore my purchase after I had purchased a second one. This year, they have nave not been able to get it to restore my purchase. After the third attempt to restore I requested a refund. They have not responded.
I'm very dissatisfied with your app and customer service. No response to emails. Yes emails. I'm being charged 6.99 a week and it's been impossible to get an explanation and cancellation.

Tried the app for 1 day. Contacted the company to cancel the app. The next day my credit card was charged. More emails with no reply. If you call the phone number there is no connection. After more emails my subscription was cancelled but the charge to the credit card remains.

They have charging my account weekly about 7-8 dollars since then while I try to cancel my subscription. They do not have an option to cancel the subscription on the app. I had contacted them numerous times over the years to cancel my subscription and they have ignored my request and kept charging my card.
I have been trying to cancel for over a month and the prompts referring to my Apple subscriptions isn't valid as it's not there.
This app is not showing up in my apple subscription so there is no way for you to unsubscribe! Do not try this app unless you want to be locked in to something indefinitely!

I found it is virtually impossible. In fact, I am still trying. The FAQs tell you to cancel within Apple settings but it is not listed there. Within the app there is no option and actually states I have a free subscription even though I continue to get charged. I tried to find a place on the website but could not even find a page to sign-in.

I signed up for the free trial because that was the only way to access any features and now I cannot figure out how to cancel the subscription. It's not showing up in the subscriptions setting of my phone and I never received any emails or information about my subscription from them except receipts for the charges they processed.
When I had the app it told me to login to be able to cancel the account I never created a login information to do that.
Does not allow to delete from phone after installing app.
I keep trying to cancel my subscription but they keep sending my an email that doesn't allow me to reset my password
There is no customer service number, when you try to reset your password, you NEVER get the email with the rest link.
Got this app with free trial to identify a plant. Now I can't cancel subscription and it charges me $8 weekly.
They intentionally make it to where you can't get it off your phone.
Spent 20 min trying to cancel in the app before reading how to do it in Apple phone/settings/ own name/subscriptions
You can't cancel in app, you have to go to you Apple subscriptions in settings (not intuitive/first subscription that I didn't even want)

items.title: Экран с выбором тарифа, заслоняющий функцию — это антиклаймакс ценностного момента
items.body: После первой попытки каждое нажатие открывает экран выбора; крестик закрытия едва заметен или отсутствует — пользователи удаляют приложение, так и не увидев продукт. Момент, когда человек тянется к камере, — самый неподходящий для трения.

evidence.quote: The only thing is that it does "remind" you to sign up for a subscription every time you open the app. I would say that's a little annoying, but other than that it's great!!

i've had this app for a while, and every update it seems like they are just trying to hide more things so you have to pay. this was a great free app to identify and find information about bugs, but its slowly drifting away from really being free.
they are sneaky about their subscriptions. Look for the very small gray "X" in the corner of the dark background when you first open the app.

I love the free app, but all the screens popping up trying to get me to take the premium app are quite a bother. I was outside on my phone, hard to see the x to close the screen, clicked on sign up for the app, then had to cancel it. Where do I contact to make sure I have not been billed?  Can find no where with contact info!
every time i go to use it it keeps asking if i want to update for only 39.99 a year
Keeps asking us to subscribe numerous times !!!!! Pay pay pay
when signing up and connecting, I get hit with a page that wants me to spend money on an annual subscription plan... THERE IS NO 'X' TO LEAVE THIS PAGE!!!
way too many popups and upsells, some which are impossible to dismiss (premium upsell has no X button! Wth?).

Auto bird identification is now behind a paywall!!! Stupidity... And every time you click the button "identify this visitor" you get a pop up to subscribe to premium! Not only do I have to click the button and wait for AI to identify the bird species but I also have to swipe away the ad.

Now every 2 taps
You get prompted to buy the membership.

I tried to scan a plant and it worked but then when I tried to do it again it said I have to pay something and blah blah blah and I’m not gonna pay a dozen dollers for a stupid plant app when I already know how to grow good plants.

After avoiding every tricky attempt to get me to accidentally subscribe to this app I was able to take one picture to try to identify a plant. The identification was wrong, so I was going to try again from a different angle, but now there is no way to skip their subscription attempts. There is definitely no way I’d…
after SEVERAL "premium free trial" & review requests pop-up's, i finally got the chance to get ONE plant pic in….before the free trial & review pop-ups attacked again non-stop
Every step wanted you to purchase the app for 7.99 a week and only usable to identify one plant. Not worth the space or $.
Every other page is some version of a sign up for payments. Mind-numbingly awful interface. Doesn't do the only thing that it should do; which is to give you direction after taking a photo.

all during the less than stellar described experience I kept getting requests to make a review ("give some love" was one obnoxious way it asked - "but we just met").  It started within less than a minute and came up every 30sec or so.

items.title: Отозванный пожизненный доступ превращает самых лояльных в самых враждебных
items.body: Покупатели «навсегда» у Sky Guide и Plantum потеряли доступ после редизайна; бэкеры Bird Buddy обнаружили, что обещанные функции стали доступны только с новым тарифом. Удар по самым ранним — это удар по самому дорогому сигналу лояльности во всём продукте.

evidence.quote: I expect certain extras to be charged or pay only but the Artemus II SHOULD BE FREE TO EVERYONE TO TRACK!! The biggest event in over 50 years and you have to pay to track it?!?! This app just lost my vote!!

I paid for this a while back but now I can't find the satellites in the app that are currently in the sky because they've switched to a subscription model and removed things that I used to have access to.
an important basic piece of functionality has been moved into the "pro" version: the display of coordinates!! This should be returned to the non-pro version. What a major disappointment.
I bought this app maybe 10+ years ago (2014?) when it was only a few dollars. I loved it. Now, I can't use it at all unless I pay at least $5 per month. The lifetime access is $250.

It's kind of upsetting that they have tiered subscription models now. I think I paid $4.99 for the app back when it came out and got all the features then. Now I have to pay again? And the wording is so gross too. "Pay $30 to see 7x more stars!" Like?? Read that out loud and tell me you don't sound greedy.

This used to be a 5 star app, but now they have things locked behind a subscription. It wasn't like that before. Even after paying for the app you have to pay monthly for all the services that used to come with the original purchase.
I purchased all constellations back in 2023 and now it's saying I have to pay monthly to get it.
with the new update users lost a great deal of compatibility satellite flyovers. I understand the cost reason but it doesn't negate users had access without upgrading to the pro version.
They will charge you for yearly subscription but monthly is all they offer now. Tried to request a refund and Apple denied for something u can't even use!
i bought this one time with a lifetime subscription. Now it wants me to purchase monthly subscriptions. scammers.
I purchased a lifetime subscription for this app 2 yrs ago, when it was under the name "NatureID". The developers changed the name of the app and cancelled my lifetime subscription.
I had a lifetime membership, less then a year later I was logged off and haven't been able to logon again. Customer service is awful, they will not reply back!
This company has removed nearly all functions available at launch and put them behind a paywall.
I was so happy with my bird buddy for several years! However with the latest app update, one of the core functions has been converted to paid subscription.
I have 3 of these feeders - a first day backer. They removed the bird identification which was the core selling point.
I bought my unit back when it identified birds. They now make you pay for identification. This is so wrong, I paid for the ID feature when it was included and now I have pay extra for it.

items.title: Запрос оценки до первого определения — это просьба солгать

evidence.quote: I think it’s good… I literally just down loaded it and they keep wanting me to review it

Wants a review before I even have a good chance to form opinion.

The app bribed me to give a 5 star review to unlock more features. I just started using it and I'm not sure about it yet. It has a 3 day free trial, after that you have to pay. 3 days is not long enough to test out a plant app imo.
I added one plant and you want a rating on the same day?
it just installed this app then it made me rate it
it's so far has only identified one plant correctly, but asked me to review after it so I'm putting it at four stars for the time being. The app should not ask so early.

evidence.app: Merlin Bird ID by Cornell Lab

items.title: Коллекция, которую нельзя перенести — это удержание с заложенной миной
items.body: Личный сад, годы наблюдений, записи птичьих голосов исчезают после обновления или смены устройства — облачной синхронизации нет. Для продукта, чья механика удержания строится на коллекции, потеря данных — это удар по собственному ядру.

Редакторы, у которых агрессивный авто-режим включён по умолчанию, теряют пользователей именно в момент первого опыта: ожидание «стать лучше» сталкивается с результатом «стать другим».

Ожидания сформированы рекламными примерами с идеальными результатами. Когда алгоритм заменяет черты лица на усреднённые или оставляет фон нетронутым, разочарование несоразмерно: это не просто плохой результат, а испорченная память.

items.title: Пресет как фирменный стиль: инструмент брендинга для контент-мейкеров
items.body: Авторы контента с выраженной визуальной идентичностью используют пресеты не как фильтры для украшения, а как инструмент поддержания постоянного стиля в ленте. Принудительная реклама между шагами разрушает это состояние. Remini получил поток однозвёздочных отзывов не за плохое качество ИИ, а за то, что каждый шаг редактирования блокировался 90-секундным роликом. sobriety.lead: Сведено из реальных отзывов 1–5★ по семи приложениям трезвости и отказа от зависимостей — от I Am Sober и Nomo до QuitNow! и QUITTR. Объединяет категорию один движок: растущий счётчик дней, который страшно потерять. Именно он удерживает людей от срыва у I Am Sober, Smoke Free, QuitNow! и Days Since одновременно — это не особенность одного продукта, а сквозной механизм жанра. Пользователи остаются годами: 5, 7, 10 лет после отказа они всё ещё открывают приложение, уже не для ежедневного ритуала, а как психологический якорь и архив достижений. Причины уйти тоже общие: пейвол в момент острого кризиса, когда человеку нужен инструмент помощи, а не экран оплаты; история прогресса, которая исчезает при смене устройства; сообщество, которое деградирует без модерации. В этой категории монетизация воспринимается особенно болезненно — взимать деньги за инструмент выздоровления считается морально неприемлемым, и приложения, выбирающие бесплатную или донейшн-модель, получают редкую в App Store лояльность: пользователи благодарят разработчиков лично и рекомендуют приложение в группах поддержки.

kids-learning.lead: Сведено из реальных отзывов 1–5★ по десяти приложениям детского обучения — от ABCmouse и Khan Academy Kids до Toca Boca, Epic и Duolingo ABC. Общий знаменатель причин уйти один: монетизация, которая давит на ребёнка и родителя одновременно — пробный период списывает полную годовую сумму в первую минуту, кнопка отмены скрыта или не работает, а платный тариф не снимает пейвол внутри приложения. Параллельно техническая нестабильность рвёт учебный момент: приложение вылетает посреди урока у Kiddopia, Khan Academy Kids и Lingokids, загрузка игр у PBS KIDS падает на праздниках, прогресс у Duolingo ABC и Epic обнуляется без предупреждения. Держат в категории противоположные вещи: измеримый академический результат у Duolingo ABC и Khan Academy Kids, структурированная среда для нейродивергентных детей, отсутствие рекламы как редкое детское достоинство — и сильная ностальгическая привязанность, которая заставляет подростков возвращаться в Sago Mini и Toca Boca спустя годы. Одни и те же механизмы — агрессивный биллинг, детские покупки без родительского барьера, контент, из которого дети вырастают за несколько месяцев — повторяются у брендов с принципиально разными позиционированиями, от «бесплатного общественного PBS» до «премиального образовательного ABCmouse».
